units.source_text: 我甚至還這樣想，在我死盯著他不放的這段時間，

en.t: I even thought this: during the time I kept staring at him and would not let him out of my sight,

units.source_text: 想方設法讓他相信，我的搞笑並非是刻意為之的「故意之舉」，而是真有其事，

en.t: I would try every possible way to make him believe that my clowning was not some deliberate act, but something real,

units.source_text: 如果順利，我還想成為他獨一無二的朋友。

en.t: and if things went well, I even wanted to become his one and only friend.

units.source_text: 倘若這一切都不可行的話，除了祈盼他早日死去外，別無他法。

en.t: If none of that was possible, there was nothing left but to pray that he would die soon.

units.source_text: 不過，我並沒有非要殺死他的念頭。

en.t: However, I had no thought of absolutely having to kill him.

units.source_text: 在我迄今為止的人生中，曾好多次希望被別人殺死，卻從未想過要殺死別人。

en.t: In my life up to then, I had often wished that someone would kill me, but I had never once thought of killing anyone else.

units.source_text: 因為我覺得，這樣反而會給可怕的對手帶去幸福。

en.t: Because I felt that doing so would instead bring happiness to that frightening opponent.
